# scripts/PlayerUtils/ClimbVolume.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/PlayerUtils/ClimbVolume.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Climbable Area3D. Flat surfaces face into the wall along local -Z; their
BoxShape3D should cover the climb and extend about 0.5 m from the wall.
Ropes use a vertical line through the origin. Entry/exit registers this
volume with bodies implementing add_climb_volume/remove_climb_volume.

Base: `Area3D`. Registered class: `ClimbVolume`.
